description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Saga of the Great Wolf enhancement HOWLMAW (WP-S2): (once per turn, per unit) at the start of the Fight phase, select one enemy unit within 6" of the Wolf Priest; it makes a battle-shock roll with -1. Fixture sw11e_s2_wolves_active (the Wolf Priest carries Howlmaw and is engaged with the Meganobz); the scenario enters the Fight phase (P1 active); setup privileges: CP 0 for both players. The fight_phase_start window shows the free HOWLMAW card; a real click on Use opens the target picker listing the Meganobz (within 6"); a real click picks them: no CP is spent, the Meganobz make a battle-shock roll at -1 (dice + verdict in the Game Log), and the Wolf Priest is marked as having used it this turn.

steps.comment: the Meganobz' battle-shock roll at -1 is logged
clean log: no ERROR line in this session's debug log
